content: Adding a custom robot to robosuite/LIBERO: (1) Create MJCF XML for the robot arm and place in robosuite assets/robots/ directory or use absolute path. (2) Subclass ManipulatorModel, implement init_qpos, base_xpos_offset, default_gripper, default_mount, arm_type='single'. (3) Register in ROBOT_CLASS_MAPPING dict with name->SingleArm mapping. LIBERO does this in envs/robots/__init__.py following MountedPanda pattern. The xml_path_completion() utility resolves robot XML paths.
